review_comment: Encoding names and values are directly interpolated into HTML table construction without HTML escaping. Utils.printable() only handles non-printable characters but does not escape HTML metacharacters like <, >, and &. Apply HTML escaping to both enc and value variables before interpolation using a dedicated HTML escaping function.

The code passes user-controlled input to an encoding library without validation, but CWE-74 requires demonstration of how the output affects downstream parsing. The decoded results are stored but their downstream usage is not evidenced. If this output flows to components that parse the content, implement input validation for encoding-specific special characters and validate the output format before downstream consumption.
